articles.summary: Johnson Matthey (JM) and Honeywell UOP, two global leaders in sustainable technologies, have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to offer an end-to-end solution for businesses developing alternative fuels from a wide range of feedstocks including municipal solid waste, residual biomass, biogas, and CO₂ (captured and renewable).
articles.title: Honeywell UOP and Johnson Matthey join forces to cut costs and boost deployment of sustainable fuels
